stories.headline: Google launches Gemini Decisions API with Gemini Decision 1, a model that scores choices

key_facts.fact: On Nov 11, 2026 Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for closed-set decisions powered by its new Gemini Decision 1 model (gemini-decision-1), available through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we're introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model (gemini-decision-1), available through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio.

key_facts.fact: Instead of generating text token by token, the model scores candidate options in a single forward pass and returns probabilities and confidence scores, for uses such as tool selection, policy checks, model routing and grading.
key_facts.excerpt: Rather than generating answer text token by token, Gemini Decision 1 scores your candidate options in a single forward pass, returning probabilities and confidence scores

key_facts.fact: Pricing is $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed, at 150-250 ms end-to-end latency.
key_facts.excerpt: returning probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end latency at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed.

key_facts.fact: One request can carry a multimodal input (text, images, audio, video, PDFs, up to 256K tokens) and up to 1,000 independent yes/no, multiple-choice or rubric questions.
key_facts.excerpt: You can pass one multimodal input across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs (up to 256K tokens) along with up to 1,000 independent questions.

key_facts.fact: Google says the Decisions API with Gemini Decision 1 is nearly 5x cheaper across its shared benchmark suite than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite with the Interactions API, and leads that suite with the lowest calibration error.
key_facts.excerpt: Gemini Decision 1 with the Decisions API is nearly 5x cheaper across the shared benchmark suite than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite with the Interactions API.

key_facts.fact: Google teams already use it internally, e.g. Gemini Notebook uses the Decisions API as a real-time router for incoming queries.
key_facts.excerpt: Dynamic model routing in Gemini Notebook: Gemini Notebook uses the Decisions API as a real-time router to instantly direct incoming queries

sources.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions

stories.headline: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2 to predict how DNA variants act in specific cell types

key_facts.fact: Google DeepMind unveiled AlphaGenome 2 on Wednesday, Nov 11, 2026, the successor to its AlphaGenome genome model released last year.
key_facts.excerpt: AlphaGenome 2 is the successor to DeepMind's genome-predicting AI model AlphaGenome, which was released last year... Google said in a blog post published Wednesday

key_facts.fact: The model predicts the effects of genetic variants on individual cell types and states and was trained on more than 100 million cell profiles across 68 tissues.
key_facts.excerpt: AlphaGenome 2 was trained on more than 100 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues to give it that more detailed view.

key_facts.fact: DeepMind says AlphaGenome 2 identifies nearly twice as many variants that change gene expression in cells as its previous state-of-the-art model, and can predict for new cell types without retraining.
key_facts.excerpt: AlphaGenome 2 identifies nearly twice as many variants that can change gene expression in cells than its previous state-of-the-art model.

key_facts.fact: Genomics lead Ziga Avsec said cell-type specificity matters for drug development because drugs target specific proteins and cell types; the predictions are more computationally expensive than the original AlphaGenome's.
key_facts.excerpt: "When you develop drugs, you're targeting specific proteins and specific cell types," he explained

key_facts.fact: Google is making AlphaGenome 2 available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API, with a limited private preview for commercial research.
key_facts.excerpt: Google says it is making AlphaGenome 2 available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API from today, with a limited "private preview" for commercial research.

sources.title: Google's AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease

stories.headline: AWS releases free AWS Emulator, a local cloud stand-in written and maintained entirely by AI agents

key_facts.fact: AWS released AWS Emulator on Wednesday, Nov 11, 2026; it simulates AWS services on a developer's own machine, built from more than 400 API models covering more than 200 AWS services.
key_facts.excerpt: AWS Emulator, released Wednesday, simulates AWS services on a developer's own machine. It's built from more than 400 API models covering more than 200 AWS services.

key_facts.fact: AWS senior principal engineer Matt Goldberg wrote that the emulator was written entirely by autonomous agents and the team has not written or reviewed any of the code.
key_facts.excerpt: "The emulator was written entirely by autonomous agents. Our team hasn't written or reviewed any of the code," wrote Matt Goldberg

key_facts.fact: Agents run on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore in three teams (writing fidelity tests against real AWS, running them and filing issues, and fixing issues); Goldberg says hundreds of agents fix thousands of issues a day.
key_facts.excerpt: Goldberg wrote that hundreds of agents now fix thousands of issues a day.

key_facts.fact: The project began as a weekend experiment in which the Kiro coding agent built a passable version of Amazon SQS in 15 minutes, inspired by Anthropic's demonstration of Claude agents building a C compiler.
key_facts.excerpt: Goldberg gave Kiro a three-step prompt and got a passable first version of Amazon SQS, AWS's message queuing service, in 15 minutes.

key_facts.fact: AWS released it free under CC0 with full commit history on GitHub; an IDC analyst noted it does not yet simulate throttling, outages or regional differences, and it competes with LocalStack.
key_facts.excerpt: AWS released its emulator for free under CC0, a public domain dedication, with the full commit history on GitHub.

sources.title: AWS gives developers a free local stand-in for its cloud, built from scratch by AI agents

stories.headline: Russian pranksters posing as Ukraine's spy chief duped three OpenAI national security officials

key_facts.fact: The Intercept reported on Nov 11, 2026 that Russian comedy duo Vovan and Lexus tricked three senior OpenAI national security officials into a 17-minute video call by posing as Rustem Umerov, head of Ukraine's Foreign Intelligence Service.
key_facts.excerpt: Russian pranksters impersonating Ukraine's foreign intelligence chief tricked three senior OpenAI national security officials into discussing potential military AI cooperation with Kyiv, according to a recording published online and a report by The Intercept on November 11.

key_facts.fact: The officials were Sasha Baker, head of national security policy; Caroline Zier, lead for strategic initiatives; and Ben Crampton, who leads European national security work.
key_facts.excerpt: The OpenAI officials on the call were Sasha Baker, who runs national security policy at the company; Caroline Zier, OpenAI's lead for strategic initiatives; and Ben Crampton, who leads the company's work on European national security matters.

key_facts.fact: On the call, Crampton said many senior people at OpenAI are reluctant to get involved in offensive military uses of its technology, while Baker said OpenAI had been in contact with the Pentagon about helping Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: "There's a general reluctance on the part of many people who are senior in the company to get too involved in offensive uses of our technology in a military context," Crampton explained

key_facts.fact: The officials mentioned work with Ukraine involving Daybreak Blue, an OpenAI model for finding and fixing security vulnerabilities, and early contacts with Ukraine's Defense Ministry.
key_facts.excerpt: The officials also discussed work with the Ukrainian government involving Daybreak Blue, an AI model designed to identify and help fix computer security vulnerabilities

key_facts.fact: OpenAI spokesperson Nate Evans said the company launched an investigation weeks ago, acted internally and with the relevant authorities to conclude it was a prank, and took action to prevent similar situations.
key_facts.excerpt: "Weeks ago, we launched a thorough investigation into the call's authenticity," OpenAI spokesperson Nate Evans said... "We took action to prevent similar situations from happening in the future."

key_facts.fact: The recording, titled "Prank with AI Management", was posted by the duo on Rumble on Wednesday; the pranksters reached OpenAI through a Ukrainian official in San Francisco who was in contact with Baker.
key_facts.excerpt: according to Vovan and Lexus' video "Prank with AI Management" posted Wednesday on Rumble

stories.headline: United Airlines blocks third-party AI agents from booking tickets, citing privacy and FAA rules

key_facts.fact: United Airlines said on Wednesday, Nov 11, 2026 it will restrict unauthorized third-party personal AI agents from its booking systems, both on its own digital platforms and indirectly via travel agencies and aggregators.
key_facts.excerpt: United Airlines is restricting access to its booking systems for unauthorized third-party personal AI agents, the company said on Wednesday. The restrictions will apply within United's digital platforms and through travel agencies and aggregators

key_facts.fact: United said sharing account credentials with AI assistants can expose sensitive information and lead to unintended purchases, account changes or use of MileagePlus miles.
key_facts.excerpt: United warned that sharing account credentials with third-party AI assistants could expose sensitive information and lead to unintended purchases, account modifications or the unauthorized use of frequent-flyer miles.

key_facts.fact: The airline also cited FAA and Transportation Department rules: check-in requires a human to acknowledge bags carry no banned items such as explosives.
key_facts.excerpt: It also said automated AI actions could violate Federal Aviation Administration and Transportation Department rules... An AI agent can't, for example, attest during check-in that bags don't contain explosives.

key_facts.fact: Agents can still show United flights and fares but cannot complete the purchase; CEO Scott Kirby said at an event on Tuesday: "To be honest, I don't want to create another middleman."
key_facts.excerpt: While agents can still show users United flights, they won't be able to actually complete the transaction on their behalf... "To be honest, I don't want to create another middleman," United CEO Scott Kirby said

key_facts.fact: The decision could limit newer personal assistants such as Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots; Amazon has blocked Meta's Muse agent, while Expedia and Booking work with OpenAI.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon has blocked Meta's AI agent Muse, while Walmart has partnered with it. Meanwhile, online travel firms such as Expedia and Booking are working with ChatGPT-parent OpenAI.

stories.headline: Tencent's Pony Ma says half of staff should shift to AI-native work; company denies layoff reading

key_facts.fact: At Tencent's 28th-anniversary Linktime livestream on Nov 11, founder Pony Ma said he is willing to redeploy half of the roughly 100,000-strong workforce to AI-native businesses.
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent Holdings Ltd.'s billionaire founder Pony Ma said he's willing to deploy half of his troops to AI-native businesses, urging his 100,000-strong workforce to embrace an era-defining technology.

key_facts.fact: Ma compared core businesses to an army and AI efforts to a navy: "The army must leverage AI to maximize its efficiency, while we redeploy 50% of our personnel to the navy to support AI-native businesses."
key_facts.excerpt: "The army must leverage AI to maximize its efficiency, while we redeploy 50% of our personnel to the navy to support AI-native businesses," he said

key_facts.fact: On Nov 12 Tencent PR director Zhang Jun called online claims that Tencent would lay off half its staff a pure misunderstanding and a rumor, saying the 50% was a figure of speech for reallocating staff.
key_facts.excerpt: On November 12, Tencent public relations director Zhang Jun rejected that reading on Weibo... He said the 50% figure was largely a figure of speech for reallocating staff and that the layoff claim was completely untrue.

key_facts.fact: Ma also called for a flatter organization with fewer middle managers; management framed it as a proactive AI-era push, distinct from the reactive cost-cutting drive launched a few years ago.
key_facts.excerpt: Management distinguished this latest initiative from the cost-cutting and efficiency drive launched a few years ago... This time, Tencent is proactively positioning itself for the AI era

key_facts.fact: Tencent had 115,927 employees at June 30, so half the company means close to 58,000 people; Tencent has not said how many staff will actually change roles.
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent had 115,927 employees at June 30... so half the company means close to 58,000 people. Tencent has not said how many staff will actually change roles

stories.headline: AI sales-agent startup Rox raises $100M Series B at a $1.3B valuation

key_facts.fact: San Francisco-based AI agent developer Rox said on Wednesday, Nov 11, 2026 it raised $100 million in a funding round valuing it at $1.3 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: AI agent developer Rox said on Wednesday it had raised $100 million in a funding round that valued the company at $1.3 billion

key_facts.fact: The Series B was co-led by General Catalyst and March Capital, with existing investors Sequoia Capital and Factory and new investors Databricks Ventures and Prosperity7 Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: The Series B round was co-led by General Catalyst and March Capital, with participation from existing investors Sequoia Capital and Factory and new investors Databricks Ventures and Prosperity7 Ventures

key_facts.fact: Rox builds AI agents that automate sales work (lead generation, booking meetings, managing deals) and says its annual recurring revenue grew more than tenfold in its first year; customers include Puma, Groq and Ramp.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's annual recurring revenue grew more than tenfold in its first year in the market, Rox said

key_facts.fact: Rox said it will use the funds for AI research, custom models and expansion into healthcare, industrial, financial services, energy and technology customers.
key_facts.excerpt: Rox said it would use the funds to advance its AI research, develop custom models and expand its enterprise customer base across the healthcare, industrial, financial services, energy and technology sectors

sources.title: Automation startup Rox raises $100 million at $1.3 billion valuation
